text: Bitcoin is holding firm near $84k despite a slight pullback, while Ethereum is treading water—a divergence suggesting selective strength rather than broad conviction. The Fear & Greed index at 71 and climbing signals sustained optimism, though Bitcoin's dominant 58.3% share and $113B in daily volume indicate the rally remains concentrated in the largest assets. Altcoin weakness (BNB and most majors down) alongside isolated gains in SOL point to traders rotating cautiously rather than entering risk-on mode wholesale.
